items.l1: 因此，上方的空气必须加速，导致其压强下降，这一现象由伯努利原理所描述。
items.notes: Faithful; low score is synonym spread (consequently/therefore, accelerate/speed up, decrease/drop), not looseness.

items.l1: 巡航期间，这些力被精心地平衡，从而得以持续平飞。
items.notes: Faithful clause for clause; blind back landed almost verbatim on gold, so the first score reflects wording variance only.

items.l1: 这些操纵面偏转时，会改变气流模式，产生局部压强变化，从而引发所需的运动。
items.notes: Faithful; Chinese must front the 'when deflected' clause and name the surfaces, which shifts word order and lowers lexical overlap.

items.l1: 公共汽车很大。
items.notes: Faithful; 'A bus' vs 'The bus' is an article Chinese cannot mark naturally, so the short sentence scores low on overlap alone.

items.l1: 他们也可以骑自行车。
items.notes: Faithful; only spread is a bike vs bikes and too vs also, which Chinese does not mark.

items.l1: 它们变成深色的泥土。
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: 'make dark dirt' after breaking down means turning into it; 变成/泥土 is the natural Chinese, soil vs dirt is synonym spread.

items.l1: 他们可以等以后再做事。
items.notes: Loose: 等一等 adds a 'wait a little' minimiser the gold lacks; rewrote to plain 'wait until later to do things'.

items.l1: 添加厨房残渣时，避免放入肉类、乳制品或油腻的食物，因为它们会吸引害虫并产生难闻的气味。
items.notes: Faithful; 会 covers the gold's 'can', and oily/greasy, odors/smells, including/putting in are synonym spread.

items.l1: 豆子长在植物上。
items.notes: Faithful; singular 'A bean ... a plant' vs plural is number/article Chinese leaves unmarked, which tanks overlap on a five-word sentence.

items.l1: 这些袋子被放到大船上。
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: Chinese needs a placement verb for inanimate bags where English says 'go on'; boats vs ships is synonym spread.

items.l1: 在历史上，这个体系发展壮大了。
items.notes: Loose: 不断 added a 'kept/continually' aspect and the register was raised above the simple gold; rewrote to plain 'grew', also fixed ASCII comma.

items.l1: 公开是好的。
items.notes: Several faithful renderings: dummy 'It is good to be open' has no Chinese analogue; 公开 carries the transparency sense the trust context needs.

items.l1: 它让程序感觉良好。
items.notes: Literal match of an odd but complete gold; 程序 kept for consistency with the neighbouring sentences.

items.l1: 有时候,孩子们跑得很快时会摔倒,受一些小伤。
items.notes: Faithful; low score from forced clause reordering. ASCII commas match the rest of this document, so left for a doc-wide punctuation fix.

items.l1: Seeing the robot start moving, my younger brother said with shining eyes, "Next I want to make a robot that I design myself."
items.notes: Faithful; gold folds the speech into と目を輝かせていた and uses plain form, neither of which English can mark. Just under floor.

items.l1: Venture capital plays an important role in taking risks to raise funds for promising startups and supporting their growth.
items.notes: Faithful, including the gold's own 資金調達 wording; spread is 将来性のある vs 有望な and 担う vs 果たす.

items.l1: Every morning, I help feed the chickens.
items.notes: Faithful; low score from plain vs polite form and 鶏/餌 vs kana spelling, which English cannot signal.

items.l1: For the purpose of objective corroboration of the crime, it is only through this meticulous matching work that infallible identification is achieved.
items.notes: Faithful to 経て初めて and 不可謬; spread is formal-vocabulary synonyms (裏付け/立証, 不可謬/間違いのない).

items.l1: Injuries occur.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's unusual 外傷が出ます vs the everyday けが, a lexical choice English 'injuries' cannot pin down.

items.l1: They put a first aid kit in their bag.
items.notes: Faithful; English needs the subject and possessive the gold omits, and 救急処置のキット vs 救急箱 is lexical spread.

items.l1: They also put in adhesive bandages.
items.notes: Faithful; spread is 絆創膏 kanji vs kana spelling only.

items.l1: The people of Rome build a tall bridge in a big city.
items.notes: Faithful; gold is spaced all-hiragana for young readers, so any kanji back-translation scores low on surface overlap.

items.l1: It is for carrying water.
items.notes: Faithful; English requires the 'It' subject the gold drops, plus spaced-hiragana surface mismatch.

items.l1: They build it by stacking stones.
items.notes: Faithful; English needs subject and object the gold omits, and gold is spaced hiragana.

items.l1: This is precisely because, in the process of countless agents continually adapting on the basis of limited information, unintended innovations and systemic risks suddenly manifest.
items.notes: Faithful, 'precisely because' carries からに他ならない; spread is 主体/エージェント, 突発的/突如, 顕現/顕在化 synonyms.
